# awscc_appfabric_ingestion (Resource)

Creates a data ingestion for an application using AppFabric.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) The name of the application.
- `app_bundle_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the app bundle for the ingestion.
- `ingestion_type` (String) The type of the ingestion.
- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the application tenant.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) A map of the key-value pairs of the tag or tags to assign to the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ingestion.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp of when the ingestion was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `state` (String) The status of the ingestion.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp of when the ingestion was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) Tag key.
- `value` (String) Tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_ingestion.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ingestion

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_appfabric_ingestion.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_appfabric_ingestion.example "arn"
```
